pages.title: Electronics
pages.text: Electronic components are the building blocks of SteamCraft machines. You will need $(bold)Wire$() and $(bold)Circuit Boards$() for almost every powered device. Wire is made from Copper Rods; Circuit Boards combine Wire with Copper Coils and an Iron Plate.
Circuit Board — the core component in batteries, scanners, and monitors.

pages.title: Tip
pages.text: Set up a steady supply of Copper early on — you will use a lot of it. A $(bold)Copper Coil$() requires several Copper Rods, and a single Circuit Board uses two coils. Plan ahead and stockpile before starting big builds.
